title: Do Dogs Blink Back When Their Owners Blink?
mediaSource: dog blinking at owner close up, dog human eye contact, pet communication research, dog facial expression

scenes.title: What if your dog blinks back at you?
scenes.narration: A new study found that dogs blink more often when they watch their owners blink. And researchers say it may be more than a simple reflex.
keywords: dog blinking owner close up real photo
pet dog facial expression close up

scenes.title: They reacted more to their owners
scenes.narration: Researchers showed thirty-five dogs videos of their owners and of unfamiliar people. The dogs blinked more when they watched their own owners blinking.
keywords: dog behavior research human face video

scenes.title: Strangers did not trigger the same response
scenes.narration: The interesting part is that the same increase did not appear when the dogs watched strangers blink. So they may not have been responding to eye movement alone.

scenes.title: Could blinking be a social signal?
scenes.narration: Blinking normally protects the eyes. But researchers think that between dogs and humans it could also work as a subtle social signal linked to attention or familiarity.

scenes.title: It does not automatically mean love
scenes.narration: That does not mean every blink is a sign of affection. The researchers say they still cannot confirm whether dogs are deliberately using blinking to communicate with us.

scenes.title: Dogs may notice our smallest signals
scenes.narration: Dogs may be reading more than our voices and gestures. They could even notice something as small as a blink. Next time you make eye contact with your dog, try blinking slowly.
